description: FinOps / billing models across the catalog. How usage is metered and billed. meta carries the billing model (pricing category), method, provenance_date, primary_unit (what the provider bills by) and `template: true` on sweep output that restates the FinOps framework without a unit, meters or a pricing category. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

method.description: Who wrote the file: "searched", "probed", "generated" (unverified sweep output), "unmarked".

q.description: Free text over name + description, e.g. "sms".

sort.description: Order: relevance (catalog order), provider, or name.

tags.description: Tag slugs, e.g. ["payments"]. On providers: what the company does (see api_tags).

name: find_finops
